01Why now

Why this course, and why now

The last step is less about diagrams than about influence: making a case a board can fund, choosing what to build, buy or partner on, and growing a team of engineers and agents. This level is practice, built around one strategy you write and defend.

04The lab

Your architecture strategy

Write an architecture strategy for a real or realistic organisation, then present it. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Describe the organisation and what it needs
  2. Draw the capability map
  3. Decide build, buy or partner for each gap
  4. Write the roadmap in three horizons
  5. Write the business case
  6. Write the board paper and prepare for questions

What the health check looks for

  • Every roadmap item ties to a business need
  • Every build-or-buy choice states its cost and exit
  • The board paper fits on two pages
